app.name: OpenCaribe
app.tagline: The marketplace built for our islands

home.heroSubtitle: A free, open and secure classifieds marketplace for Trinidad and Tobago and Venezuela. Browse on any phone, on any connection.
home.countriesSubtitle: Local currency, local language, local community.
home.trustTitle: Built with you, not just for you
home.trustPrivacy: Privacy by default. No exact addresses are ever required.
home.trustFree: Free to browse. Low-bandwidth pages that load on modest devices.
home.trustOpen: Open source. Auditable, translatable and community owned.

search.noResults: No listings match these filters yet.

listing.safetyNote: Meet in a public place and never send money before seeing an item.

post.subtitle: Three short steps. No account needed to start a draft.
post.draftNote: Drafts are reviewed before they appear publicly.

legal.placeholder: This document is a starter template. It must be reviewed by qualified local counsel before production launch in each country.

payment.title: Payment options
payment.cryptoDescription: Connect your Adena wallet to settle a listing on-chain. Available soon.
payment.walletNote: Wallet connection is not available yet. No payment will be requested.
payment.sellerNote: Crypto is optional and never required to contact a seller.
payment.pageIntro: We are preparing an optional way to settle marketplace transactions with the Adena wallet.
payment.step1: Choose a listing and agree on a price with the seller.
payment.step2: Connect your Adena wallet when the feature is released.
payment.step3: Confirm the payment in your wallet and keep the receipt.
payment.safeNote: OpenCaribe will never ask for your seed phrase or private key. Inspect the item before you pay.
payment.siteBanner: Pay with crypto using your Adena wallet — coming soon
